checks.name: Current queue policy and session state are prepared together
Queue names and display labels come from the same current cohort
Advisory preparation changes no catalog, transfer or accepted-command guard
Start does not prepare an unused queue selector
A suppressed queue prompt does not prepare unused names and labels
A fresh Start preparation observes session rejection without changing an earlier result
A real writer precedes Start/Later preparation
Preparing an action returns while Manager is held and claims no accepted guard
One File Info owner cannot duplicate its outstanding action reader
Cancelling advisory acquisition settles before the external writer releases Manager
An unrelated accepted command defers the action reader
Advisory cancellation never clears another command's guard
A read failure is returned without retaining a worker or accepted command
The same owner can retry after consuming a read failure
A throwing wake cannot undo a published action result
A missing download cannot authorize an action
A stale strong selection is checked against current catalog membership
